card.why_meaningful: A Base head and a Gap head can receive different messages from the same evidence group. Source restart preserves the originally read evidence against repeated mixing. Tests conditional group disagreement without making extra memory requests.

card.corechain: For EACH hyperedge separately, compute context-independent static node embeddings and dynamic multihead attention embeddings excluding self. Retain separate static/dynamic position-wise networks and LayerNorm, then q_ve=(dynamic_ve-static_v)^2. This vector discrepancy, rather than attention alone, is the transferred core.
card.decision: ACCEPT as one complete core with explicitly replaced output task
card.distinct_from_others: Only candidate with separate static and leave-self-out contextual representations and elementwise squared discrepancy. It evaluates each predefined hyperedge rather than diffusing node states over graph rounds.

exact_mapping.graph: shared_mapping exactly; incidence occurrences of the same node share input but have different dynamic context
exact_mapping.parameters: One source EncoderLayer; both static and dynamic position-wise networks128→128→128; source residual/LN settings retained (dynamic residual, static no residual); separate output LayerNorm for each branch. diag_mask=True, dropout=0. Every edge has at least two nodes, so leave-self-out softmax always has an allowed key.
exact_mapping.readout: q_e=mean_{v in e}q_ve. q_H=mean eight same-head q_e; q_T=mean 1–3 evidence-type q_e. Concatenate original projected Local128,q_H128,q_T128; Linear384to128 then common zero-initialized Linear128to1600 Flat correction. Replace source scalar sigmoid hyperedge classifier/average probability with this task readout, not the static/dynamic discrepancy block.

card.why_meaningful: Directly measures whether an evidence component agrees with other components in its actual group while retaining its standalone representation. This is a disagreement-sensitive fusion mechanism, not merely attention under a famous model name.

card.corechain: Predict a diagonal restriction map per node–hyperedge incidence from node and current edge features; construct lifted sheaf incidence; normalize, transport node fibers into each edge, aggregate and transport back; apply learned stalk/feature transforms and nonlinearity. Recompute maps at the next layer.
card.decision: ACCEPT runnable author-code-defined diagonal SheafHyperGNN variant; not the nonlinear HyperGCN variant
card.distinct_from_others: Structured per-incidence linear maps plus a normalized lifted diffusion operator, not scalar node attention. Diagonal stalk maps remain learned feature-dependent transport; do not count orthogonal/general variants as more papers.

exact_mapping.operator: Pin author diagonal-convolution behavior including source order: H has incidence blocks F_ve (nd×Ed); D_(v,j)=sum_e f_ve,j^2, clamped at 1e-6 before inverse square root; B_(e,j)=|e|. Let R=D^-1/2. Source first computes X_pre=R Z, then Q=R H B^-1 H^T and output=(I+Q-2*blockdiag_node(Q)) X_pre+b. Equivalently A=R H B^-1 H^T R and P=R+A-2*blockdiag_node(A), output=PZ+b. The leading term is R, NOT I, because source pre-normalizes the input. Z=(I_n kron W_left4x4)X W_right32x32. ELU only after first layer, no extra residual. Dense construction follows this author-code convention; do not add source persistent shape caches.
exact_mapping.parameters: Reshape learned node128 into mathematical fiber4×32, NOT spatial or memory-head coordinates. For each layer a_v=mean over four stalk rows; a_e=mean active a_v in edge; f_ve=tanh(Linear64to4([a_v,a_e])); F_ve=diag(f_ve). dynamic_sheaf=True, MLP_var2, special_head=False, dropout=0, left_proj=True, sym_block_norm, independent layer weights.

The original code caches hyperedge attributes/shape-dependent identity masks; recompute them per utterance and layer because graph sizes vary.
Diagonal maps may approach zero; epsilon stabilization is an explicit adaptation.

card.why_meaningful: Incidence-specific feature transport permits the same Base head to express different coordinates in head-compatibility and evidence-type groups. Tests agreement in learned group spaces without forcing all Base/Gap node vectors to be identical.

code_evidence.finding: Parent-specific votes, zero logit initialization, parent competition, squash and cumulative dot-product agreement.

card.distinct_reason: Agreement is accumulated into per-input routing logits and followed by vector squash; there is no GRU state, covariance posterior, or balanced transport constraint.
exact_mapping: Use all active common-contract tokens. For each of 33 typed positions i and each parent j in 1..4, compute a 32-vector vote uhat_ij=W_ij x_i with W_ij in R^(32x64), bias-free. Exclude inactive i from every sum and agreement update.
Reset b_ij=0 on every utterance. In each of three rounds: c_ij=softmax over the four parents; s_j=sum_active_i c_ij uhat_ij; v_j=q/(1+q) * s_j/sqrt(max(q,1e-8)), q=sum_d s_jd^2.
After rounds 1 and 2, b_ij += dot(uhat_ij,v_j); the equivalent unused last-round logit update may be omitted. Do not detach votes or intermediate routing logits.
Concatenate the four final 32-vectors in learned-parent order to produce z in R^128. All-inactive/no-history guards follow the common contract.
card.hypothesis: Parent-specific transforms may combine mutually consistent Local/Base/Gap votes while allowing incompatible evidence to support different latent groups.
card.input_output_mask: Inactive votes and their logit updates are zero/excluded. Parent states are temporary within the utterance; output is hard-zero outside valid-history rows.
limitations: Agreement can amplify correlated or redundant read heads.
Four groups and three rounds are fixed preregistered choices, not evidence of optimality.
Capsules are latent evidence groups; no object/pose or missing-modality reconstruction claim.
card.local_conditioning: Local appears as one lower capsule and conditions all Base/Gap tokens in the shared input adapter; parent logits are still initialized to zero, preserving routing-by-agreement.
original_to_adapted_changes: Replace visual lower capsules with typed read-head vectors.
Use the paper's bias-free sum rather than the optional bias in released code; use zero-safe squash.
Output capsule vectors, not class probabilities; omit image convolutions, margin loss and reconstruction decoder.

code_evidence.finding: Shared Gaussian parameters, bias-free Q/K/V, competition over slots, input-axis weighted mean, GRU and residual MLP.

card.distinct_reason: The essential chain is competition -> normalized evidence summary -> GRU state update -> residual refinement, not just a different softmax axis.
exact_mapping: Use common-contract tokens, then per-token LayerNorm64 and bias-free K,V projections 64-to-64. Re-mask after normalization.
Initialize four slots s_j=mu+exp(log_sigma)*epsilon_j using shared learned 64-vector mu and log_sigma. Set log_sigma=0 at initialization, mu Xavier; slots do not have separate learned means.

Training: use a dedicated branch-owned torch.Generator(device='cpu'), initialized with seed (experiment_seed+104729) modulo 2^63. Its state is held in a persistent uint8 checkpoint buffer named training_noise_rng_state. Before each executed training call, restore this private CPU generator from training_noise_rng_state.detach().cpu(); draw independent standard-normal float32 epsilon[N_active_history,4,64] on CPU using only that generator, in the existing batch-row order; then save its updated state back to the persistent buffer and transfer epsilon to the slot device/dtype. No call to global manual_seed, randn without this generator, or CUDA random generation is allowed. Thus the branch noise consumes neither baseline global CPU/CUDA RNG nor dropout/mask streams. If no row has valid history, skip the draw and leave private state unchanged.

Strict checkpoint loading and full training resume restore training_noise_rng_state before the next branch draw; do not reseed it from experiment_seed after loading. The state buffer follows module checkpoint/device handling, while generator.set_state receives a CPU copy. A complete resume additionally restores the original optimizer/progress/global RNG states under the unchanged experiment protocol. Evaluation uses one fixed epsilon_eval[4,64] sampled once with a separate isolated CPU generator seed 1729, saved as a persistent checkpoint buffer and broadcast to all rows; evaluation neither draws noise nor changes the private training RNG state. Reset slot state for every utterance.
For exactly three rounds, compute logits_ij=dot(K_i,Q(LN(s_j)))/sqrt(64); A_ij=softmax_j(logits_ij). Form W_ij=mask_i*(A_ij+1e-8)/sum_active_k(A_kj+1e-8); update_j=sum_i W_ij V_i.
Set s_j=GRU64(update_j,old_s_j); then s_j += Linear128to64(ReLU(Linear64to128(LN(s_j)))). Share all refinement weights over slots and rounds.
Apply shared phi=Linear64to64+GELU to final slots; concatenate mean_j(phi(s_j)) and max_j(phi(s_j)) into z in R^128. This symmetric readout does not attach class meaning to slot indices.
card.hypothesis: Competition followed by a learned recurrent update may allocate different temporary slots to complementary evidence groups, rather than only reinforcing instantaneous agreement.
card.input_output_mask: Inactive input rows are excluded before the epsilon renormalization, not merely zeroed as values. All-inactive rows bypass the core. Final z follows valid-history hard-zero guard.
limitations: Task-only supervision may produce redundant or source-specialized slots; no object-discovery claim.
Fixed evaluation noise is a disclosed adaptation and must be held constant across checkpoints/seeds, not chosen using test results.

Stochastic training needs the persistent private RNG-state buffer as well as the original training state for exact resume; changing active-row batching changes private draw assignment and is not claimed trajectory-equivalent.
card.local_conditioning: Local is a real input token and conditions each memory token through the shared adapter. No extra query is made against OSRAM; Q refers only to temporary slot-to-token attention.
original_to_adapted_changes: Read-head token features replace image features.

Fixed common-random-number evaluation replaces the reference implementation's random evaluation draws; training retains Gaussian resampling but uses an isolated, experiment-seeded, checkpointed CPU generator to preserve the baseline dropout/mask RNG streams. This RNG isolation is an engineering adaptation, not a claim about the original implementation.
Symmetric mean/max readout replaces object decoder or set-prediction head; only original task loss is used.

Log-domain alternating marginal scaling and dot-product support similarities.

card.distinct_reason: Assignments are coupled through both source and target mass constraints and a learned reference geometry. Thirty Sinkhorn updates solve this constrained allocation; they are not independent attention or recurrent slot updates.
exact_mapping: On active tokens compute h_i=normalize(ReLU(Linear64to64(x_i)),eps=1e-8); re-mask. Learn four support vectors z_j in R^64, Xavier initialized, and normalize each with the same epsilon. These are persistent parameters, not cached sample state.

Construct C_ij=-dot(h_i,z_j). Use uniform source mass a_i=1/n for n active tokens and target mass b_j=1/4. Solve the entropy-regularized OT approximation with exactly 30 differentiable log-domain Sinkhorn rounds.

For packed active rows, logK=-C/0.5; initialize log_u=0, log_v=0. Each round: log_u_i=log(1/n)-logsumexp_j(logK_ij+log_v_j); log_v_j=log(1/4)-logsumexp_i(logK_ij+log_u_i). Then T=exp(logK+log_u+log_v). Unpack inactive rows as exact zero.

Use the paper's unit-mass normalization: Phi_j=sqrt(4)*sum_i T_ij h_i. Flatten four 64-vectors and apply Linear256to128 to obtain z. Do not collapse supports to an ordinary mean before the learned output projection.
The OT entropy term defines the internal transport plan; it is NOT added to the training loss. All references, nonlinear map and output projection train only through the original task loss.
card.hypothesis: Global mass constraints can discourage all read evidence from collapsing into a single support and retain several complementary summaries despite varying numbers of missing modalities.
card.input_output_mask: Operate on packed active tokens so zero-mass inactive rows never enter logarithms. The empty set returns zero before Sinkhorn. No-Gap uses exactly nine tokens; no-history correction remains zero.
card.license: No repository license located in inspected root/README; do not copy source. This card specifies an independent mathematical adaptation.
limitations: Uniform target capacity may force weak evidence into a support; this is the intended bias being tested.
Finite Sinkhorn iterations approximate the source marginals; marginal residuals must be logged in unit checks, not turned into an extra loss.
No claim of a discovered object, calibrated uncertainty, or recovered missing latent.
card.local_conditioning: Both the Local token and Local-conditioned memory tokens enter the transport problem. References remain global learned parameters as in the source; no label-conditioned or per-dialogue reference cache.
original_to_adapted_changes: Use the source-supported neural nonlinear feature map rather than a Gaussian Nyström approximation; do not claim the original Gaussian kernel guarantee.
No positional encoding or sequence convolution because heads have no spatial order.
Use paper sqrt(p)*T aggregation; official OTKernel returns p*T-style per-support means, a known fixed scale difference.
Random supervised parameter initialization replaces unsupervised K-means pretraining; no new objective or dataset pass.

code_evidence.finding: Per-child/per-parent trainable matrix transformations produce vectorized matrix votes.
Uniform initialization, sufficient-statistic/conjugate updates, expected-log responsibility calculation and entropy-based final activation.

card.distinct_reason: Unlike dynamic routing, agreement uses learned-matrix votes and uncertainty-aware Gaussian statistics with fixed conjugate priors; unlike Slot Attention there is no GRU; unlike OTKE there are no forced equal target masses.
exact_mapping: For each common token x_i, create M_i=reshape(Linear64to16(x_i),4,4) and a_i=clamp(sigmoid(Linear64to1(x_i)),1e-6,1-1e-6). Use per-type projection maps. Inactive inputs have M_i=a_i=0 after where, regardless of biases.

For each typed input position i and parent j in 1..4, learn W_ij in R^(4x4); set v_ij=vec(M_i W_ij). Use one fully connected grouping region; no spatial unfolding, coordinate addition or sequential neighborhoods.
Initialize r_ij=1/4 for active i. Each of three rounds computes w_ij=a_i r_ij, N_j=sum_i w_ij, mean_j=sum_i w_ij v_ij/max(N_j,1e-8), and scatter_j=sum_i w_ij(v_ij-mean_j)(v_ij-mean_j)^T.

Posterior parameters: alpha_j=1+N_j, kappa_j=1+N_j, nu_j=17+N_j, m_j=N_j mean_j/kappa_j, invPsi_j=I+scatter_j+(N_j/kappa_j)mean_j mean_j^T. Use Cholesky with 1e-6 I numerical jitter and solves, not an unstable explicit inverse.

Compute Elogpi_j=digamma(alpha_j)-digamma(sum_k alpha_k), Elogdet_j=16 log(2)-logdet(invPsi_j)+sum_(d=0..15)digamma((nu_j-d)/2). For rounds 1 and 2, score_ij=Elogpi_j+0.5 Elogdet_j-0.5*(16/kappa_j+nu_j*(v_ij-m_j)^T solve(invPsi_j,v_ij-m_j)); r_ij=softmax_j(score_ij). Round 3 finalizes posterior statistics.

Choose the released-code entropy-activation variant explicitly: H_j=8*log(2*pi*e)-0.5*Elogdet_j; A_j=sigmoid(beta_a_j-exp(Elogpi_j)*H_j-beta_u_j), with learned beta_a=beta_u=0 initially. Omit source BatchNorm on means/activation so rows cannot affect one another.

Concatenate the four A_j*m_j vectors (64 scalars) and four A_j scalars, then Linear68to128 gives z. For N_j<=1e-8 force A_j and its weighted mean output to zero; whole-row no-history/all-inactive guards apply.
Unroll the closed-form posterior calculations with gradients; do not add an ELBO, KL, reconstruction, spread/margin loss, posterior sampling, VAE path, or labels to the readout inputs.
card.hypothesis: Posterior shrinkage and covariance-aware agreement may prevent small, contradictory head groups from acquiring overconfident assignments when few Gap heads are active.
card.input_output_mask: Inactive rows contribute zero mass, no scatter and no assignments. Temporary posterior statistics reset every utterance. No batch normalization, persistent posterior cache or sample mixing.
limitations: This is a deterministic differentiable Bayesian-routing computation, not a claim of calibrated Bayesian uncertainty for emotion prediction.
16-dimensional matrices are learned arrangements of features, not poses.
Cholesky/statistical updates cost more than the other three grouping cores; small current-read sets keep the design bounded.
The selected entropy activation and normalization choices differ from the published equation, so label it adapted VB routing, not exact reproduction.
card.local_conditioning: Local-conditioned common tokens produce all lower matrices and activations. The Local vector participates once; no geometric interpretation is attached to its matrix reshape.
original_to_adapted_changes: Use one nonspatial fully connected group and typed readout-derived matrices.
Preserve full-covariance conjugate updates from Algorithm 1; omit image backbone, coordinates and source classification head.
Select the official code's entropy activation rather than claiming it equals paper equation 14; the code omits the paper's outer mass factor and uses exp(Elogpi)*entropy.
Omit post-routing batch normalization for utterance isolation; numerical floors and output projection are declared adaptations.

card.corechain: Learned latent queries cross-attend to the input set; repeated latent-only self-attention processes the compressed representation; an explicit output query cross-attends to the processed latents. Preserve attention projections, normalization, residual connections and feedforward sublayers in all three stages.
card.decision: ACCEPT: complete encode-process-decode core with current-conditioned output query
card.distinct_from_others: Unlike DGCNN there is no kNN graph. Unlike GMT there is no explicit adjacency or GNN-generated key/value. Unlike SetTransformer, processing stays exclusively in a latent array instead of returning to all input tokens after each inducing exchange; decode uses Local, not a fixed bank of output seeds.

exact_mapping.current_conditioning: Local participates in the input set and separately determines the output query, so the processed evidence summary is requested for the current utterance rather than decoded with a task-constant seed.
exact_mapping.decode: q=Linear256to128(safe_Local)+learned_query_bias128, shape[1,128], with its own projection independent of input Local projection. One four-head CrossAttention(q,Z4), query residual disabled as in BasicDecoder default, then its residual FFN128→128→128/GELU. The resulting single128 output goes to shared_mapping.integration. No new memory read occurs.
exact_mapping.encode: One independent pre-LN CrossAttention(Z0,X), four heads of size32, query residual enabled. Attention logits use sqrt(32) scaling; FFN128→128→128 with GELU (widening_factor=1). This yields Z1[8,128]. Input KV masking must exactly match token compaction.
exact_mapping.input: shared_mapping produces X[N,128]. Eight learned latent vectors Z0[8,128], initialized once as model parameters, are broadcast independently to each utterance. They are never persistent state or OSRAM slots.
exact_mapping.parameters_and_masks: No tied processing layers, no added Fourier/spatial encoding, no extra positional sequence, no dropout. Only active evidence enters encode; eight latent tokens remain valid within a processed utterance. Whole-row bypass precedes all attention for padding/no-history.
exact_mapping.process: Exactly three independent pre-LN latent SelfAttention blocks, each four heads of size32 with residual attention and residual FFN128→128→128/GELU. Equivalent configuration: num_blocks=1, num_self_attends_per_block=3, num_z_channels=128, z_index_dim=8. Do not replace these blocks by one cross-attention call or pooling.

limits: N is only9–25: the source's large-input scaling advantage is not an experimental justification here.
Depth, latent count and channel width are reduced, but all three architectural stages remain.
Input-derived output queries are supported by the paper; using this exact Local query is our adaptation, not a published OSRAM method.
Source is JAX/Haiku. An eventual PyTorch implementation must test operator equivalence without importing a new runtime or copying source without notices.

card.why_meaningful: Tests a genuine intermediate reasoning bottleneck: evidence is compressed, transformed through multiple latent interactions, and selectively decoded for Local. A single attention-pooling substitute would remove both latent processing and the Local-dependent decoding stage.

card.corechain: Recompute a feature-space neighbor graph before each EdgeConv stage; learn center-relative edge features; max-aggregate neighbors; concatenate all stage outputs; project and retain both global max and global mean pooling. The repeated topology updates and multiscale aggregation are essential.
card.decision: ACCEPT: four-stage feature-space dynamic EdgeConv backbone, not a one-layer edge operator
card.distinct_from_others: Only accepted method here uses hard, recomputed feature-space neighborhoods and center-difference edge messages followed by neighbor maxima. GMT uses fixed semantic adjacency and graph-aware soft pooling; Perceiver uses learned latent compression without graph edges.

exact_mapping.current_conditioning: Local is a full graph node at every stage, can be selected as a neighbor, and always contributes to global max/mean readout. Graph distances include learned role/head-aware features, so this is evidence similarity, not a claim of physical distance.
exact_mapping.edgeconv: Widths are c0=128,c1=64,c2=64,c3=128,c4=256. At stage r: e_ij=concat(x_j-x_i,x_i) in R^(2*c_(r-1)); z_ij=LeakyReLU0.2(LayerNorm(Linear(2*c_(r-1),c_r,bias=False)(e_ij))); x_i^r=max_j z_ij. Four stages have independent parameters. Neighbor selection is discrete; selected feature values retain gradients.
exact_mapping.graph: At each of exactly four stages, for each active node i choose the four smallest squared Euclidean distances in that stage's current feature space among all N active nodes, including i itself to match author knn behavior. k=min(4,N). Resolve exact distance ties by canonical role/head ID, not batch padding index. The graph is directed i→selected j and is recomputed independently at every stage.
exact_mapping.input: X0[N,128] from shared_mapping. No xyz, radius graph, farthest-point sampling, spatial transform network or token ordering is introduced.
exact_mapping.masks_and_no_history: Compact before distances, top-k, edge construction and pooling; padding or inactive Gap cannot become neighbors or affect maxima/means. Entire padding/no-history utterances bypass as in shared_mapping.
exact_mapping.multiscale: Concatenate x_i^1,x_i^2,x_i^3,x_i^4 into512, apply Linear512to128(bias=False)→LayerNorm128→LeakyReLU0.2. Compute both active-node maximum128 and mean128; concatenate into256; Linear256to128→LeakyReLU0.2 returns feature128 for shared_mapping.integration.

limits: Source BatchNorm is deliberately replaced by per-edge/per-token LayerNorm to avoid cross-utterance statistics and invalid-padding contamination. This is a disclosed normalization adaptation, not exact original DGCNN numerical behavior.

The source's xyz first stage is replaced with genuine learned evidence features. Later-layer feature-space recomputation is retained, but useful proximity between heterogeneous roles is a modeling hypothesis.
k=4, embedding width128 and the final task readout are new small-set choices; original point-cloud classifier/dropout is not retained.
A fixed graph or a single EdgeConv would fail the intended design. No differentiability claim is made for top-k indices at neighbor changes.

card.why_meaningful: Tests whether evidence relationships should evolve after each stage of interaction. Base/Gap affinity can change as relative disagreements are encoded; multiscale readout preserves early comparisons together with later mixed evidence.

card.corechain: Message-pass on the input graph; use graph convolutions, not pointwise linear maps, to produce keys and values for learned-seed pooling; apply self-attention among compressed nodes; pool those nodes to one graph representation. Preserve GNN-derived K/V and all three pooling stages.
card.decision: ACCEPT: GNN encoder plus complete graph-aware pooling/interseed/final-pooling chain; implement independently from paper, do not vendor unlicensed source
card.distinct_from_others: Not a SetTransformer alias: both encoder and first pooling K/V use the defined adjacency. Not DGCNN: adjacency is fixed by role/head identities, messages are normalized graph convolutions, and output uses graph-aware seed pooling rather than max/mean. Not AllSet: no node↔hyperedge incidence rounds or per-hyperedge multiset aggregation.

exact_mapping.current_conditioning: Local is the unique hub in the input graph, so each Base/Gap key and value receives Local-dependent information before pooled attention. This is separate from using Local as a decoder query and separate from dynamic-neighbor similarity.
exact_mapping.encoder: Ahat=D^(-1/2)(A+I)D^(-1/2), counting each undirected edge in both directions and self loops once. H1=ReLU(Ahat X W1+b1), H2=ReLU(Ahat H1 W2+b2), each128 channels. Concatenate H=[H1,H2] into N×256, retaining the author's jumping-knowledge concat. No BatchNorm or dropout.
exact_mapping.final_pool: GMPool_I uses one learned128 seed and ordinary linear K/V on V (identity post-pooling graph); four heads of32, scaling sqrt(128), the same MAB residual/LN sequence. Apply the author's final Linear128to128 to the resulting1×128 vector, then shared_mapping.integration. Exact stage string: GMPool_G-SelfAtt-GMPool_I.
exact_mapping.graph: Use the active tokens from shared_mapping. Undirected edges connect Local to every memory token and connect any two distinct memory tokens with the same actual head ID across Base/active-Gap roles. No edges connect different heads except through Local. Store a loop-free adjacency A; each GCN uses A+I with exactly one self-loop per node. This is a proposed role/head graph, not measured geometry.
exact_mapping.graph_pool: GMPool_G uses four learned seeds S[4,256]. Q=S Wq+bq; K=Ahat H Wk+bk and V=Ahat H Wv+bv from separate one-layer GCNs, each256 channels. Four heads of64, scores divided by sqrt(256), softmax over active input nodes. Concatenate per-head(Q_head+attention*V_head), apply LN256, then residual ReLU(Linear256to256) and LN256, matching pinned MAB behavior. Output U[4,256]. cluster=False.
exact_mapping.interseed: Exactly one source-style SAB projects Q,K,V from256to128 on U, four heads of32, score scaling sqrt(128), projected-query residual, LN128, residual ReLU(Linear128to128), LN128. Output V[4,128]. This stage models interactions among the four graph summaries; it is not removed because the final task is scalar regression.
exact_mapping.mask: Build compact graph and degrees only from active nodes. A block-diagonal batch is allowed, but no cross-utterance graph edge/statistic. Graph_pool excludes any padded KV; four compressed seeds and final seed are fully valid only for processed utterances. No-history/padding bypass is shared_mapping.

license.implementation_route: Independent equation-based implementation; no source vendoring.

limits: The proposed Local-star/same-head topology is an inductive bias; useful edges are not established by the paper and may oversmooth this tiny graph.
Do not transfer graph-isomorphism/injectivity theorems to this finite-width, continuous-feature adaptation or claim graph reconstruction ability.
GCN rather than GIN is fixed to avoid source GIN BatchNorm; GCN is explicitly supported by the official model.

Paper equation7 uses a conventional MAB presentation while pinned author MAB uses projected-query residual and sqrt(total width) scaling. The proposed numeric contract above explicitly follows the author implementation; verify it on tiny graphs.

card.corechain: Lower linear bread and ReLU -> alternating nonnegative basis/code inference -> one differentiable coefficient update -> low-rank reconstruction -> upper linear bread and normalization -> token residual and ReLU. Preserve the full chain, not just matrix multiplication.

exactmapping.critical_source_difference: Author ham.py automatically calls online_update in eval when rand_init=False. That branch MUST NOT be copied: inferred bases may never persist between utterances or test batches. Source random initialization is replaced with deterministic fresh copies to avoid introducing inference RNG drift.
exactmapping.mask_and_zero: Compact tokens before factorization; all-zero ReLU input returns zero reconstruction with epsilon denominators. Skip the entire branch if no prior history, and never infer padded tokens.
exactmapping.matrix: Compact active evidence tokens become columns X in R^(128 x N), without imposing image-grid geometry.
exactmapping.normalization: Replace upper-bread batch normalization with tokenwise LayerNorm128 to prohibit cross-conversation dependence; 1x1 convolutions become per-token linear maps. Explicit adaptation, not exact source execution.
exactmapping.output: Use common rolewise residual readout described above; do not output estimates for inactive modality slots or write inferred factors into OSRAM.
exactmapping.preliminary_parameters: Core33152 = Linear128,128(bias)16512 + upper Linear128,128(no bias)16384 + LayerNorm256. Total with proposed wrapper364480; fixed rank4 basis has512 buffer entries, not parameters. Actual count must be verified in code.
exactmapping.solver: Initialize a positive normalized128x4 basis from one fixed seed at construction; copy that same immutable buffer per utterance, then reset all inferred bases/codes after each forward. Softmax initializes codes; alternate original NMF multiplicative updates under no_grad; retain the original final differentiable coefficient update and reconstruction.

limits: Real sentiment shifts may be high-rank or minority evidence and can be suppressed.

card.corechain: PreNorm -> tied-projection multihead subspace self-attention -> residual -> PreNorm -> dictionary-gradient ISTA shrinkage with ReLU; stack complete compression/sparsification blocks. The source ISTA replaces an ordinary FFN and does NOT have a second standard Transformer residual added after it.

exactmapping.attention: One shared QKV projection W generates w, and attention is softmax(w*w^T/sqrt32)*w, followed by output projection. Preserve tied projections; substituting generic unrelated Q/K/V attention changes the core mechanism.
exactmapping.ista: Preserve source FeedForward computation: x1=Linear(x,D); grad1=Linear(x1,D.T); grad2=Linear(x,D.T); output=ReLU(x +0.1*(grad2-grad1)-0.01). D is a learned128x128 dictionary, not an independent two-layer MLP.
exactmapping.mask_and_zero: Compact active tokens per utterance or explicitly key-mask attention and zero invalid query rows after every substep. Local is always present on valid positions, so no all-masked softmax. No-history branch bypasses residual; pad bypasses all computation.
exactmapping.output: No source CLS token required: use transformed real Local and memory rolewise differences through common wrapper. No additional OSRAM query or recurrent state.
exactmapping.preliminary_parameters: Per block49792 = two LayerNorm512 + tied projection16384 + output projection16512 + dictionary16384. Two blocks99584; total with proposed wrapper430912. Arithmetic estimate, not measured.
exactmapping.task_loss: Original paper's supervised experiments use ordinary classification cross-entropy; author main.py uses LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy, then loss=criterion(output,target). Therefore no added sparse-rate objective is needed to retain the core block; MOSI keeps its existing task MSE.
exactmapping.tokens: Use compact active Local/memory-head evidence tokens; role/head identity embeddings replace image-patch positional embeddings. No image patch embedding or image-grid encoding.

card.why: Accept ONLY the complete MSSA-plus-ISTA block: jointly compressing token subspaces and sparsifying against a learned dictionary is materially different from a basic attention reweighting or a Hadamard gate. Removing ISTA would fail this screening criterion.

card.corechain: Typed set elements and temporary aggregate y -> shared learned nonnegative potential -> cardinality-scaled set energy plus positive L2 energy term -> unrolled Nesterov updates -> optimized aggregate. Differentiate through the complete inner loop using only the downstream task loss.

exactmapping.author_code_caveat: Publisher Listing2 omits the loop_body carry return statement and references np in inverse_softplus without importing numpy in that listing. These publication-code omissions require explicit mechanical repair when porting; preserve its Nesterov lookahead and per-example stopping mask. Do not describe the PDF listing as a directly executed verified package.
exactmapping.backprop: Training uses explicit differentiation through ten updates, including gradient-of-energy operations (PyTorch create_graph=True), not a detached solver or approximate implicit backward. Evaluation locally enables gradients only to obtain dE/dy, detaches temporary iterates between updates and does not retain outer graphs. Under inference_mode the implementation must locally disable inference mode as well as enable grad. Never call backward on the energy to accumulate parameter gradients during inference.
exactmapping.energy: E(X,y) = [softplus(raw_lambda)*sum(y*y) + sum_over_active_i F(x_i,y)] * log2(N+1)/(N+1e-8), preserving supplementary C.1 cardinality scaling. N counts only real active tokens. This scalar is an internal forward objective, never added to MOSI task loss.
exactmapping.initialization: At every utterance and every forward reset y0=zeros128 and momentum0=zeros128. No learned init, no reuse of the previous utterance optimum, no persistent optimizer buffers. Trainable inner scalars are shared model parameters, not state caches.
exactmapping.inputs: Use the same proposed 128d tokenizer with actual Local256 and active Base/Gap head64 inputs. Role/head IDs remain attached to each token under permutation. No head adjacency or temporal index is invented.
exactmapping.mask_and_empty: Compact active tokens after safe torch.where masking before all projections. Only Local and genuinely available current memory read evidence enter. No-history positions and padding bypass the whole added branch as exact zero. Defensive N=0 case returns zero without invoking the solver. No invalid token is treated as an observed zero-valued sample.
exactmapping.not_using_pyg_shortcut: Inspected current PyG equilibrium.py only as a cross-check, not author code. It differs from the publisher listings in potential squaring, residual mapping, Nesterov lookahead and energy scaling. Copying that implementation would not preserve the core chain resolved here.
exactmapping.output: This method returns an aggregate rather than transformed token rows: send y_final128 through one zero-initialized Linear128,1600 and add to the original Flat pre-norm anchor. Therefore it does not use the tokenwise role-pool output adapter of the other two accepted cards. Original Flat, Memory, query and task head are untouched.
exactmapping.potential: Concatenate each128d token with temporary y128. Residual stages256->256->128->32: each stage has a main linear map and a skip identity or learned dimensional projection; apply tokenwise LayerNorm+tanh on the first two main branches only. The last main branch is linear. Square the final32 channels and mean them to produce nonnegative F(x_i,y). Unlike a fixed Huber centroid, this potential is learned and need not be a function only of x_i-y.
exactmapping.preliminary_parameters: Potential140608 = first stage66304 + second66048 + third8256; add three learned scalars ->140611. Shared tokenizer42880 and output projector206400 yield389891 added parameters for this exact proposal. Arithmetic estimate awaiting implementation verification.
exactmapping.solver: eta=softplus(raw_eta), mu=sigmoid(raw_mu), raw_eta initialized by inverse_softplus(.125), raw_mu by logit(.9), raw_lambda by inverse_softplus(.1). For ten steps: grad=dE/dy evaluated at y+mu*v; v_new=mu*v-eta*grad; y_new=y+I(maxabs(grad)>=1e-3)*v_new. Thresholding is per utterance, never one shared batch stopping decision. All temporary state is reset per forward.
exactmapping.training_deviation: Original experiments also use the gradient-norm auxiliary loss in main Eq5; supplementary E.3 reports its effects. The authorized task-only variant explicitly omits that outer auxiliary term. The internal positive quadratic energy term is retained because it defines the forward aggregation; it is not an extra task loss. Initial effective lambda=.1 is a fixed adaptation choice, not asserted to be the source experimental setting.

card.mechanistic_prediction_not_result: The same evidence token can exert different influence as the temporary aggregate evolves, since dF(x_i,y)/dy depends on both x_i and the current y. This permits nonlinear joint set summaries without re-reading OSRAM. Finite-step energy/gradient traces can check whether the intended iterative computation operates, but neither convergence nor smaller energy proves sentiment correctness.
card.title: Equilibrium Aggregation: Encoding Sets via Optimization
card.why: A complete learned-energy inference block: the readout representation is generated through multiple coupled optimization updates, not a simple scalar/channel gate, fixed robust mean, or one attention operation. Its expressive learned potential and unrolled inference are mechanistically distinct from Hamburger's constrained factor reconstruction and CRATE's prescribed subspace/shrinkage updates.

card.corechain: Sequential sparse feature selection -> shared+step-specific feature processing -> split decision and next-step attention -> update feature-use prior -> accumulate decision features across steps.
card.distinct_from_others: Unlike NODE's fixed-depth split conjunctions, each step conditions new feature selection on the previous transformed sample and past feature-use budget.

exact_mapping.dimensions: decision_dim64,attention_dim64; feature transformer width128; two shared GLU layers and two step-specific GLU layers per transformer; one warmup transformer followed by three sparse-selection/decision steps (four source-style passes total).
exact_mapping.input: Project Local256->64 and each safely-masked forward memory512->128 (shared memory projection). Concatenate [L64,B128,GA128,GT128,GV128,availability3], total579. Apply per-slot LN before bias-free projection, then re-mask absent slots. Preserve fixed slot meanings, not a spatial/temporal sequence.
exact_mapping.iteration: Initial full-feature pass supplies attention state but no accumulated decision. At each of3 decision steps: mask=sparsemax(prior*attention_logits) over eligible coordinates only; transform(mask*input); add ReLU(decision64); update prior*=1.5-mask. Keep invalid coordinate eligibility false independently of the prior values.
exact_mapping.loss: Original emotion task loss only; lambda_sparse=0 (source-paper ablation), no masked-feature pretraining/decoder.
exact_mapping.masking: Masked sparsemax excludes all128 coordinates of inactive Gap slots. Zero priors alone are NOT a sufficient exclusion. availability coordinates and Local/Base remain eligible on history-valid rows. Biased outputs cannot reactivate invalid raw features because original safe input is re-multiplied each step.
exact_mapping.normalization: Replace source BN/GhostBN with per-utterance LayerNorm at corresponding transform positions to prohibit across-utterance/future mixing; this is explicitly TabNet-inspired, not benchmark reproduction.
exact_mapping.output: sum of three64-dimensional decision vectors -> common zero-init residual output projection; no independent task exits.

limitations: Mask coefficients are not causal attributions.
LN and learned-latent input replace source GhostBN/raw columns, so original TabNet accuracy claims do not transfer.
End-to-end learned features can make feature selection unstable; the experiment may fail.

card.title: TabNet: Attentive Interpretable Tabular Learning
card.why_meaningful: Tests whether staged selection with a feature-use budget can extract complementary Local/history combinations rather than globally scaling Memory once.

card.corechain: Sparse feature choice -> learned threshold/temperature decisions at each tree depth -> products over complete split paths -> learned leaf response vectors -> densely connected tree layers.
card.distinct_from_others: Not a single scalar gate: complete path probabilities select vector leaf responses, and later ensembles operate on earlier ensemble representations. Distinct from graph message passing, competitive grouping and matrix factorization.

exact_mapping.dimensions: 3 dense-connected layers,32 trees/layer, depth4, leaf response width2; layer input widths579/643/707; all96 tree outputs retained as192-dimensional representation.
exact_mapping.initialization: Construct finite provisional thresholds=0 and log_temperatures=0 with initialized=False, allowing fresh zero-bridge evaluation without mutation or NaN placeholders. Source-style data-aware threshold/temperature initialization replaces them from detached valid history-bearing rows of the FIRST NORMAL TRAINING batch with such rows, under forked RNG, using the same per-sample masked selectors as forward. No additional OSRAM scan, label use or optimizer step. Floors ensure finite log temperatures. Save initialized flag and parameters; prohibit automatic initialization from validation/test. Small first-batch sample size is a recorded risk, not silently enlarged training protocol.
exact_mapping.input: Same579-dimensional fixed-slot vector as TabNet: Local64 + four safe projected history128 + availability3. No input image/token sequence. Per-slot LN, bias-free projections and post-projection masking.
exact_mapping.masking: Inactive raw Gap coordinates stay exact zero before every tree layer. Selection logits for those raw coordinates are excluded with per-sample masked entmax; previous tree features are allowed because they summarize safe evidence. This sample-specific eligibility extends source shared selectors; their learnable scores remain shared.
exact_mapping.normalization: No external quantile preprocessing, QHAdam, checkpoint averaging or source optimizer changes. Original cfg84 optimizer/protocol retained; only branch per-slot LN used.
exact_mapping.operation: Feature selection entmax1.5 and two-class entmoid1.5;16 leaves per tree; each deeper layer sees original input and all earlier tree outputs. Do not replace path-product with a generic MLP.
exact_mapping.output: concatenate192 -> common zero-init residual output projection; existing task head unchanged.

limitations: Learned latent coordinates differ from static source tabular columns; no interpretable sentiment-rule claim.
Per-sample inactive-coordinate exclusion is a deliberate adaptation of shared selectors.
Small-batch data-aware initialization and near-saturated tree paths require numerical correctness tests; no guaranteed benefit.
